episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A recurring nightmare takes Greta back to the moment that changed her life 15 years ago, only for her to wake up and find the nightmare ever present.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A former prosecutor tracks Greta down seeking answers about his assassinated daughter, placing Greta's husband, Jacek, in a mix of half-truths.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Curiosity turns to fear when Kamila starts noticing strange occurrences at the house across the road, and decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: In the wake of new threats, and after facing Jimmy for the first time since the incident, Greta is shaken enough for Karol Wespa to get involved.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As she begins to piece the gaps in her memory, Greta suddenly finds herself vulnerable and face-to-face with a life-threatening situation.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The truth finally surfaces when Jimmy shares an archival video with Greta, rocking the foundation of what she thought she knew about her husband.
